features.name: Approval Workflow Templates in Power Automate
features.description: New action in Business Central pages that support approvals to create approval workflows directly. Templates have been improved to support real requester details, approval requests via adaptive cards in Teams, and cancel scenario support.
caveats: Must be enabled in feature management for upgraded environments
Enabled by default only for new BC 2023 wave 2 environments

features.name: Automated Flow Templates Based on Business Events
features.description: 17 new automated flow templates that trigger on external business events from Business Central, allowing notifications in Teams when events like customer blocking or purchase order release occur.
features.status_evidence_quote: the concept of business events is is new in business Central and it's still in preview
caveats: Business events feature is still in preview

features.name: Instant Flow Templates
features.description: New instant flow templates for scheduling visits, creating summary emails, and summarizing inventory across companies.

features.name: Dynamic Company and Environment Support in Power Automate
features.description: Flow actions no longer require company specification to list API categories or tables. Uses standard variables and environment variables to make flows work across different companies and environments without hardcoding.
caveats: Requires use of environment variables for environments which needs AL-Go support

features.name: List Companies Action in Connector
features.description: New action in the Business Central connector that returns all Business Central companies for a given environment, enabling flows that operate across multiple companies.

features.name: Business Events Trigger
features.description: Power Automate trigger to react on business events that occur in Business Central code. Allows automation based on special events from Microsoft code or custom events created by partners using AL construct.
features.status_evidence_quote: the concept of business events is is new in business Central and it's still in preview
caveats: Business events feature is in preview
Can be triggered from any company or specific company in an environment
Partners can extend with custom business events

features.name: Updated Business Central Connector Icons
features.description: Changed icon theme for Business Central connectors to make it easier to distinguish between online and on-premises versions.

features.name: Webhook notification row limit increase
features.description: Webhook notifications from Business Central to Power Automate increased from 100 rows to 1,000 rows, enabling flows that react to bulk changes.

features.name: Connector V2 actions deprecation
features.description: V2 actions in the Business Central connector will be hidden from December this year. Existing production flows will continue to work, but editing flows requires updating to V3 actions.
features.status_evidence_quote: from December this year all of those V2 actions will be hidden and you won't be able to see them again
caveats: Production flows continue to work but must be updated to V3 when edited

features.name: Canvas apps for Business Central
features.description: Power apps designed for mobile experience with full UI control. Work with Business Central through connector, dataverse virtual tables, and support phones or tablets.

features.name: Sample apps and canvas app guidance
features.description: New sample apps provided to help get started with canvas apps. Documentation and guidance included for making apps look good, easy to maintain, and properly engineered.

features.name: Dataverse virtual tables for Business Central
features.description: Technology that virtualizes data from Business Central so it appears in Dataverse as native tables. Enables rich integrations with Dataverse apps and other Dynamics 365 apps.
features.status_evidence_quote: this technology virtual tables for business Central uh is going to be generally available later this year
caveats: Currently in preview, GA later this year

features.name: Assisted setup for Dataverse virtual tables
features.description: Simplified setup process in Business Central assisted setup to enable Dataverse virtual tables. Users can choose which tables to virtualize, enabling them one by one or in bulk.

features.name: Power Pages integration with Business Central
features.description: New product from Power Platform with preview integration via Dataverse virtual tables, delivering later this year. Enables building portals and websites exposed externally with authenticated access for external users in B2B scenarios.
features.status_evidence_quote: in later in this year we will um deliver a preview version of our integration
caveats: Preview opt-in experience at the beginning
Requires mapping external users to customers

features.name: Power BI embed experience improvements
features.description: Enhanced control over Power BI reports and dashboards in Business Central embed experience. Includes zoom level control, page control with memory, and support for Power BI scorecards.

features.name: Power BI scorecard support in Business Central
features.description: Power BI scorecards are now viewable from within Business Central. AL code components added to allow control of scorecards from AL code.

features.name: Data sync technology for Dataverse
features.description: Technology that allows syncing data to Dataverse, primarily for connecting to other Dynamics 365 products.
